[[Category:Critical thinking]]
[[File:Think about it.png|thumbnail|Don't assume!]]
'''Media literacy''' refers to the capacity to apply [[critical thinking]] to

* access
* understand
* analyse
* evaluate
* create

[[media content]] to

* obtain relevant, accurate and up-to-date factual information,
* form informed opinions,
* share factual information and opinions with different [[audience]]s, minimising bias and maximising ease of comprehension.
